thread:
incident-bot: Paging oncall Marc R. — Canary failures detected for `release/2026-11-models` (model v3.2.1). 7/10 canaries returned tokenization errors. Escalation level: P1.

Marc R.: acknowledged, I'm looking now. Can you dump the canary logs and the model metadata?

Sara L.: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abc/canary?vars=release%2F2026-11-models — latency spikes + error-rates for canaries hitting the tokenizer code path.

Jia W.: I pulled logs from canary-3: `ERROR tokenizer: unknown token id -1 for input "\uFFFD"` repeating. Also seeing mismatch between tokenizer checksum and model metadata: model artifact `tokenizer.sha256` != deployed `tokenizer.sha256` in manifest.

Ryan K.: that sounds like a packaging/config drift during the build->release step. The weights upload was correct but tokenizer tarball appears from older build. Possible release pipeline race.

Marc R.: copying commands I'm running: `rictl inspect release/2026-11-models --json | jq .artifacts` — will confirm checksums.

deploy-bot: Trigger received: `flip_feature_flag feature.model.v3.2.1.enable`. Only owners can flip during P1. @Ryan K., @Marc R., confirm.

Ryan K.: Confirmed. We should flip the feature flag to halt rollout while we validate. Flag: `feature.model.v3_2_1_rollout` -> set to `off`.

Marc R.: I'll flip and then instruct deploy to rollback canaries to v3.2.0.

Marc R.: flipping flag now: `curl -X POST https://config.redwood/api/flags -d '{"key":"feature.model.v3_2_1_rollout","value":false}'` — 200 OK. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: `feature.model.v3_2_1_rollout=false` by Marc R.

Sara L.: errors dropped to baseline within ~30s after flag flip. Canary error-rate down from 45% -> 2%.

Jia W.: Verified tokenizer checksum mismatch: deployed manifest lists `tokenizer.sha256 = 3f8a9d...` but release artifact in GCS is `b7c4e2...`. Looks like an upload step in CI used an old tokenizer tar.

Marc R.: rolling back canaries to v3.2.0 now via `rictl rollout --target release/2026-11-models --to-tag v3.2.0 --scope canary` — started.

deploy-bot: Rollback job queued: job-id 0a4f2b. Progress: canary-1 -> completed, canary-2 -> completed, canary-3 -> failed to restart (node OOM), canary-4 -> completed.

Marc R.: canary-3 failure unrelated to model; evicting and rescheduling. Continuing rollback.

Maya C.: FYI CS: we have tickets from 3 paying customers reporting garbled chat output around 16:12 UTC (matches canary window). I'll open priority PSR tickets and notify account teams.

Sara L.: monitoring synthetic tests (prompts) against v3.2.0 show stable outputs. We'll keep flag off until we verify packaging fix and run a new canary with correct tokenizer.

Jia W.: root cause hypothesis: CI caching bug in `tokenizer-build` step. When artifact cache miss happened, the pipeline reused previous cached tarball but updated weights blob — producing model+weights pair that don't match tokenizer mapping. Need a reproducible failure test in CI.

Ryan K.: I created issue infra#458 to add checksum verification between `weights` and `tokenizer` artifacts before publishing. Also adding a pre-release validation job that runs tokenization sanity checks on a sample corpus.

Marc R.: Next steps: (1) keep rollout flag off (done), (2) confirm rollback completed (monitoring green), (3) coordinate with CI to patch and run new build, (4) schedule a controlled canary with human gates.

Sara L.: ops note: set alert `canary_tokenizer_errors > 5%` to paging. Lowering threshold so early detection next time.

Maya C.: CS note: emailed affected accounts with status + workaround (switch to pinned model v3.2.0). Will follow up when root cause fixed.

Ryan K.: handing off to night oncall @Jia W. Jia, I'll add you to the infra#458 PR review.

Jia W.: taking over for night. I've pulled the CI logs and reproduced checksum mismatch locally. I'll push a fix and kick a new build.

Marc R.: Thanks team. Leaving incident open for followup validation. If CI fix passes and we do a safe canary re-rollout, we'll create a new thread for the re-release.

incident-bot: Incident P1 acknowledged by Marc R. Status: mitigated (rollback + flag off). Followup: postmortem required, owner: Ryan K., due: 48h.

Sara L.: quick note for postmortem: customer-visible impact window 16:10–16:18 UTC, affected canaries 7/10, root cause suspect: tokenizer artifact mismatch.

Marc R.: I'm adding logs and timeline to the incident board. Night team - ping me if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
